content.short: StreamingFast builds Firehose and Substreams, high-throughput blockchain indexing technology for The Graph.
content.description: StreamingFast is a core developer on The Graph and the team behind Firehose and Substreams, an indexing approach that streams chain data through composable transformation modules rather than replaying blocks through a handwritten indexer. A transform can be pointed at a network and backfill years of history in minutes.
